name: habit-tracker
description: Habit and fitness tracker built for the Full Stack Developer exam

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @habit-tracker/contracts && npm run build --workspace @habit-tracker/server && npm run build --workspace @habit-tracker/client
scripts.development: npm run contracts:build && concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run development --workspace @habit-tracker/server" "npm run development --workspace @habit-tracker/client"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @habit-tracker/contracts && npm run test --workspace @habit-tracker/server && npm run test --workspace @habit-tracker/client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @habit-tracker/server && npm run test:coverage --workspace @habit-tracker/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @habit-tracker/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @habit-tracker/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @habit-tracker/client
